properties.name: MEASURED on 0.77.0: TemporalFact.basis takes measured | forecast, and record_finding's published schema, describe_schema (served through `--call`) and the one-round-trip refusal all name those values. So this friction is not the door's. The confusion it reports is structural: the word `basis` carries four different value sets on TemporalFact and the edges around it, and the provenance words the reporter tried (`inferred`, …) belong to a fifth property, `provenance`
properties.statement:
FROM THE 2026-10-02 TRIAGE (agent B), root-cause skill fetched fresh. Tool friction "TemporalFact.basis is `measured | forecast`; the provenance words (`inferred`, …) are refused" in art:vscode-call-door-field-report-2026-10-02.

⑤ MEASURED through `--call` on scratch stores:
- record_finding with basis "inferred" exits 1: "Validation error on TemporalFact.basis: invalid enum value 'inferred', expected one of [\"measured\", \"forecast\"]". So one round trip, values named.
- stdio tools/list: record_finding.basis is enum [measured, forecast, null] with a description.
- `--call describe_schema {"node_type":"TemporalFact","budget_chars":200000}` gives the node property basis = [measured, forecast]. It also shows, on the edges a TemporalFact carries:
  - CONSTRAINS.basis = [estimated, evidence, measured];
  - CAUSES.basis = [observed, correlational, causal, spurious];
  - DUPLICATES.basis = [asserted, suspected].
- Requirement.provenance = [authored, planned, inferred, healed, reconciled, imported].

CAUSE: one property name carries four value sets within one hop of a TemporalFact, and the everyday sense of "basis" (how do you know?) matches `provenance` better than the stored meaning (measured or forecast, i.e. tense). The door is not a cause: the values are reachable under `--call` in two ways before the call and in the refusal after it.

NOT ESTABLISHED: whether a rename or an alias is warranted. That is vocabulary and is Anthony's call (rule:design-intent-moves-only-on-the-owners-word). This records the overload only. `steps` puts the lesson on record_finding for MCP clients; a door agent will meet it only once I5/req:the-cli-describes-any-tool-with-its-full-schema-and-lessons lands.
